notes: Fix Offline wake sound/interval NVS persistence (ArduinoJson |nullptr, feat_* boot load, feat_fb_int key length).

history.notes: Fix Offline wake sound/interval NVS persistence (ArduinoJson |nullptr, feat_* boot load, feat_fb_int key length).
Fix Offline wake sound persistence: ArduinoJson |nullptr read, boot loads feat_* NVS keys.
Fix Offline wake sound and OTA URL not persisting (ArduinoJson | nullptr string read).
Replace Mario/Tetris with original Arcade wake jingle; rename Play every label.
Offline wake melodies: Mario and Tetris sine motifs (cascade and other sounds unchanged).
Offline wake sound: test button and selectable repeat interval.
Alarm offline wake tone (beep/chirp) after stream watchdog gives up.
Web UI no longer pushes stale volume on page open; sliders sync from the device first.
Orange-red track gradient on all range sliders.
Range sliders show step tick marks on every HTML page.
Snooze slider: full-width track with integrated fill; alarm fade slider gets tick marks.
Fixed snooze status text encoding on scheduler.html (ISO-8859-1 safe separator).
Snooze slider keeps a fixed 0–60 min scale while counting down; dragging always sets a new duration.
Scheduler snooze layout: 50/50 split between timer info and slider; steps 0, 1, 5, 10 … 60 min.
Scheduler snooze slider: full width, compact labels, discrete steps at 1 min then every 5 min up to 60 min.
Scheduler snooze timer: select box replaced with a live countdown slider that moves toward zero; dragging sets a new duration and restarts the countdown.
Web UI save feedback: all settings pages now show bottom-right success/error toasts when configuration is saved (sound EQ, volume, config, scheduler, display, OTA URL, maintenance).

Scheduler snooze timer: when you pick a duration on scheduler.html the device stores the shut-off time and the page shows a live countdown (remaining time and radio off at HH:MM). Active snooze state is restored on page load via getJSON.

Hardened configuration persistence: partial saves no longer write alarms to NVS at all (only explicit alarm saves do), empty alarm arrays in patches are ignored, invalid alrm_config at boot is no longer auto-reset to factory defaults, obsolete alrm_start/alrm_stop legacy keys are removed after migration, and the Web UI no longer injects default 6:30-7:30 alarms when loading or saving.

Fixed alarm schedules being silently reset to the factory default (6:30-7:30) when saving unrelated settings such as alarm fade or display options. Partial config saves now always seed alarms from the authoritative alrm_config NVS key instead of a stale radio_config blob. The Web UI no longer substitutes default alarms on load errors, and alarm count reductions are logged as warnings in the Power Log.

Fixed alarm schedule inconsistency: the Web UI could show a different (stale, default) alarm than the one the firmware actually used, because alarms live in a separate NVS key (alrm_config) while the Web UI read a cached copy in the radio_config blob. The Web UI now always shows the real active schedule, the cached copy is healed on boot, and every alarm save keeps both in sync.

Fixed a rare hang where the Web UI became unreachable (device still online) for several minutes: the live-status (SSE) push from the main loop could block on a dead/half-open browser connection until the TCP timeout expired. SSE events are now only sent when the network send buffer has room, a stuck client is dropped after a short grace period, and the blocking flush was removed - so the main loop stays responsive.

The scheduler setting is now called 'Alarm volume fade' and is used for both directions: an alarm fades the volume in from silence to your set level when it starts, and the snooze/sleep timer now fades the volume out gently over the same duration before stopping, instead of cutting off abruptly.

Power Log now records runtime errors and warnings in addition to boot/shutdown events: WiFi loss, stream connect failures, stream watchdog stalls, OTA/upload failures, config save errors, VS1053 detection problems and more. Events are deduplicated to protect flash wear and shown on the Power Log page with Error/Warning badges.

New Power Log page: the last 20 shutdown and boot events are recorded in NVS and shown in the Web UI. Planned shutdowns store their reason (user request, firmware update/upload, NVS erase, stream-stall recovery); unexpected ones (power loss, brownout, crash, watchdog) are inferred on the next boot. Each boot is logged with date and time when the NTP clock is available, otherwise as unknown time (and patched once the clock syncs).

Saving a setting now only changes that one parameter: partial config saves no longer revert the current volume, station or tone and no longer reset unrelated feature flags (dark mode, VU meter, watchdog) to their defaults. The Alarm volume fade-in is fixed - changing it no longer makes the volume jump and it now takes effect immediately without a reboot; it is the time to ramp from silence up to the configured volume and is set in 5-second increments. Added host-based unit tests (pio test -e native) covering the config merge, volume mapping and step quantization.

OTA page can now install a specific release (including older ones = downgrade) picked from a list that is auto-detected online from the repository releases folder, so only firmware images that really exist are offered. Manual .bin uploads now show a brick-risk warning and are validated (minimum/maximum size, ESP32 0xE9 image signature and chip type) both in the browser and on the device before flashing. Online volume (Web UI sliders) now changes only in 5-step increments to match the rotary encoder, enforced in the browser and on the device.

Stability and structure release: user volume 0-100 now maps onto the audible VS1053 range with 5-step encoder increments and immediate persistent save; fixed leftover third digit in the TFT volume readout; OTA update screen no longer shows artifacts and reliably shows size and estimated time (dashboard rendering is paused during flashing); thread-safe stream metadata, non-blocking client stop, HTTP read fix; enlarged app partitions and reorganized source into domain folders.
MP3 Stream page responsive layout: viewport meta tag and index.html-style panel structure for smartphones; mobile CSS for full-width action buttons, volume slider, and help text wrapping.

MP3 Stream page redesign: scan LAN folder via ESP32 proxy (?mediadir=), track list with Play all, sessionStorage keeps playback across Web UI navigation, and firmware reconnects interrupted LAN streams before Content-Length is complete.

New MP3 Stream page (mp3stream.html): play MP3 files from your PC or phone over the local network with a guided UI, auto-detected media server Base URL, copy-to-clipboard for the python3 HTTP server command, immediate playback on file or folder selection, and fixed URL decoding for encoded stream paths.

Improved OTA reliability and UX: static WebUI assets now use ETag/Last-Modified with conditional 304 responses, local OTA upload shows progress modal from upload start through install, and OTA TFT screen performs a full black clear to prevent leftover graphics.

Introduced local firmware upload via ota.html with direct installation, plus a unified modal workflow that blocks interactions during update and reports completion after the device service is reachable again. Applied the same wait/recovery UX to online OTA updates. Moved Alarm volume fade control from display page to scheduler page for better feature ownership.
Reworked the Play button live visualization from JS class blinking to a CSS-driven animated icon effect and moved the stream kbps pill into the metadata panel heading on a single line.

Reduced startup pop/pfffftt artifacts by decoupling amplifier enable from immediate volume writes and moving unmute/fade-in to decoder-confirmed start timing. Added stream warmup gating before enabling audio output and an extra one-time cold-boot warmup window for the very first automatic stream start after device boot.

Optimized live status updates to save resources: SSE remains primary, polling fallback is now adaptive (active/idle/background intervals) with retry backoff and visibility-aware scheduling. Added stable preset state synchronization from live payloads and settings load so the active preset button is always highlighted correctly after refresh. Simplified index preset UI by removing redundant current-label text and keeping visual active-state only. Display alarm fade setting now supports 0-60 seconds.

Fixed stream URL parsing for manually entered URLs (including scheme handling), added Enter key submission for Play Stream input, and stabilized stream bitrate reporting by preventing measurement spikes during counter resets. Index live status now reports stream_kbps via measured bitrate with fallback to header bitrate. Play button blink is now JS-driven in 1-second toggles while playback is active. Live stream meta panel is shown only when playback is active and stream kbps is greater than zero.

Diagnostics endpoint now includes chip, CPU, reset, memory, flash, network, and partition details for better incident analysis. OTA start screen now hard-clears the full display to black to prevent stale UI artifacts. Display settings page was modernized (time selects, fade slider, immediate save, start/end validation). Stream watchdog controls were moved from display to configuration with persistent autosave. Multiple pages were aligned to the newer sound-style UI layout.

Webserver stability release: robust HTTP request parsing to avoid partial-header timeouts, getconfig now prefers stored radio_config blob (NVS key scan fallback only on invalid/missing blob), favicon served as 204 No Content with caching, SSE live updates restored with automatic polling fallback, static pages/assets cached for 10 minutes, and Raw Configuration moved from config page to maintenance page.

BLUETFT dashboard: song title wraps across multiple lines (22 characters per line, up to 8 lines below station name). Web UI: faster page load — WiFi signal API uses scan cache (optional scan=1), OTA check returns embedded manifest without blocking HTTP, theme and preset list load after static assets, improved yield during large CSS/JS transfers.

BLUETFT song title on TFT using the same direct-refresh path as the station row (icystreamtitle, single line below station, content-column X offset). Bitrate label normalized to kbps on station change. Rotary encoder preset switch while streaming fixed.

Modern TFT dashboard for BLUETFT (160x128): vertical volume bar with % on the left, vertical VU meter on the right, header with date and time, WiFi SSID with signal bar and quality % (same curve as Web UI), station name, wrapped song metadata, status line, play indicator, optional battery line in header. No layout overflow.

OTA install fix: dual OTA partition table (ota_app.csv), HTTPS firmware download, restart only after successful update. Dark mode on all Web UI pages including preset select. Navigation from nav_menu.html (build-time embed). VU meter: 2px bar, improved activity display.

VU meter fix: visible yellow activity bar below the top line on BLUETFT/ILI9341 (displaytype set at boot). HTTP/SSE no longer block normal requests. Web UI GET queue, SSE polling fallback, config save race fixes. SPI claim timeout prevents display/audio deadlock.

Multi-client HTTP, SSE live updates, stream watchdog (auto-reconnect). Alarm fade-in, snooze rename. Auto dark mode (configurable hours). VU meter and WiFi/IP on TFT. Diagnostics page, captive portal, OTA version check. Android companion app. Display/behaviour and OTA subpages in Web UI.
Bugfix radio scheduler.
Alarm scheduler fix: NTP time via getLocalTime each second, weekday from SNTP, reliable minute matching, validated alarm times, auto-save on scheduler changes.
Stream metadata fixes: keep last title on empty blocks, robust StreamTitle parse, no permanent metadata disable on large blocks, JSON escaping in getJSON.
Song title history: last 10 recognized stream titles with date/time in Web UI JSON.

Web UI overhaul: responsive nav (Unicode icons), Scheduler alarm row layout, Maintenance page. Config: preset drag-and-drop reorder, collapsible raw JSON editor. Index: volume slider, separate play/stop, display on/off panel.

Alarm scheduler fixed: weekday check, reliable start/stop, per-second task handling. Boot preset select lists only configured presets. Scheduler alarm times as hh:mm masked inputs. Clock/NTP labels and tooltips. WEBUI_CACHE_MAX_AGE. Soft volume fade on play start/stop.
Configuration auto-saves on field change. UTC offset and DST as select boxes. Sound settings moved to Sound Settings page. HTTP POST config save fixed. Scheduler alarm remove persists to NVS.
Web config as JSON/NVS with form UI. Scheduler page (sleep timer, alarms). Preset reorder. Bugfixes playlist redirect, EEPROM/config load, alarm save.
Code switch from Arduino IDE to VSCode PlatformIO. VS1053 semaphore bugfixes. Time format expanded with date.
IR remote control recognition removed. defaultprefs.h structured.
writeDefaultConfig.h for default props in NVS on problems. SD card disabled. Display WiFi network list on TFT.
MQTT removed, mute button removed from index.html. Hardcoded GPIO pins for rotary encoder, TFT, and VS1053. Web interface layout adapted.
Bugfix alarm start/stop not working after ESP32 Espressif-Systems update to 3.3.0.
Rotary encoder click and double-click logic: click = radio on/off, double-click = select radio station.
Update ESP32 Espressif-Systems platform from v2.0.17 to 3.3.0.
Song title API for web interface (icystreamtitle and icyname). Sleep timer to stop MP3 stream after a defined time. Const VERSION renamed to FIRMWARE.
Bugfix HTTP server for root directory "/". HTML tags and stylesheets adapted for menu.
Responsive Design meta tag added to adapt content on different screen sizes.
Reload time changes on problems with the data connection.
